children: Bulten’s board proposes an EGM resolution authorizing repurchase of up to 200,000 shares, estimated at approximately SEK 16.9M at SEK 84.30 per share, excluding transaction costs. The proposals require shareholder approval.
Repurchase up to 200,000 shares for plan
Creates a company-funded share pool for the proposed executive option plan; authorization is not yet approved.
Based on 200,000 shares at SEK 84.30 each; this is an estimate, not a committed expenditure.
Options cover ~0.95% of shares and votes
Potential dilution is limited but increases the share count if options are exercised and repurchased shares transferred.
Up to 200,000 options for senior executives
The proposal links executive incentives to share performance; the CEO is excluded.
The plan and buyback require shareholder approval, including support from at least 90% of votes cast and shares represented.
This is a proposed executive incentive and share-delivery plan, not an approved buyback or completed issuance. The next catalyst is the December 16, 2026 EGM vote on the linked resolutions.
Based on the original press release from Bulten AB distributed by MFN by Modular Finance.
